children: has halted its work with cargo operator 21 Air following a deadly freighter accident at Miami International Airport, where five people on the ground were killed.
The carrier operated Flight 7598, a Boeing 767 freighter that left the runway after landing on Sept. 6 and collided with two vehicles. Five additional people were injured in the incident.

The National Transportation Safety Board said cockpit recordings indicated that one pilot called for the landing to be discontinued after the aircraft touched down at a high speed. The investigation remains ongoing.

Amazon said it had been assisting investigators and reviewing circumstances surrounding the accident before deciding to suspend operations with 21 Air. The company said it would continue supporting those affected and the investigation.
21 Air said it remains confident in its safety procedures and training. The carrier also said it is cooperating with the NTSB, Amazon and other parties as authorities examine the crash.

title: Worrying News For Amazon Stock Fans
